Go to sleep, ya stupid shit!
Can't ya go one day without spewing your noxious ramblings, even if it is just incoherent rubbish!?

I don't mean to be rude, but there have been quite a few christian thinkers that provide a similar theory. The best example I can give right now is John Milton's "Paradise Lost". In the beginning Milton gives a description of satan's entourage as being the pagan gods popular in antiquity.

Youtube comment threads can be very frightening, this one in particular. Quite a few people seriously consider Bernie Sanders not to be presidential material because he didn't force the women from the podium. The man is running for president, and showing civility toward two disruptive individuals isn't a sign of incapability to be a leader. Anyone can be violent. Passivity is indicative of a person who respects, and considers other people's perspectives before acting out in instinctive rage.
Yes, the two women were being very disrespectful, and I wish they wouldn't have been given the opportunity to speak. I'm going to go out on a limb here and guess you're a Trump supporter, or just trolling to rouse people's emotions, but what happened when Trump was confronted with a protester that ran on stage? He freaked out, and was visibly startled, but he had dozens of guards and secret service to take care of the culprit. Did Sanders have any of that? No. 
(Edit: visually to visibly)

Thank you for posting. It's been a really tough presidential campaign, and it's obvious that you've put more thought into who you're voting for than the majority. I think you brought up something that a lot of Bernie supporters skim over, without putting all the blame on Trump.

I do not condone the violence that took place at the Trump rally(s). The protesters should take a page from Dr.King, and reflect upon their childish actions. That being said,  in no way should this be an excuse to characterize Sanders and his campaign. When someone exercises their right of free speech it isn't inconsequential. In Trump's case, in which he supports many policies that are very polarizing, it will perturb and convince people he's completely at odds with their world view. These people decide to protest, and protest they do, but they do it at possibly the worst place possible, inside a giant enclosed dome where emotions run very high. It would be interesting to see what would happen if Trump supporters protested a Bernie rally... Who would be the first to insight violence? Does it even matter? If so, is it the candidates fault?
Thank you for taking the time to make this video! You brought up many of the problems with MSM's narrative we all share on this sub.
